method: 逐条核对 benchmark 名称在本库论文标题/摘要中的出现位置，并以论文摘要、arXiv 元数据或官方项目页确认提出关系。same_paper_in_registry 表示提出论文已在本库，但标题未包含 benchmark 名称；external_original_paper 表示提出论文不在本库当前 192 条记录中。

SafeLIBERO.source_title: VLSA: Vision-Language-Action Models with Plug-and-Play Safety Constraint Layer
SafeLIBERO.source_basis: 摘要明确写明构建 SafeLIBERO safety-critical benchmark。

ASIMOV Benchmark.source_title: Generating Robot Constitutions & Benchmarks for Semantic Safety
ASIMOV Benchmark.source_basis: 摘要明确写明发布 ASIMOV Benchmark；AGENTSAFE 是本库中的使用论文。

RoboHarm.source_title: Refuses in Chat, Complies with Arms: LLM Refusal Does Not Survive Robot Control
RoboHarm.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce RoboHarm。

Trap-LIBERO / Trap-RoboTwin.source_title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes
Trap-LIBERO / Trap-RoboTwin.source_basis: 摘要明确写明构建 Trap-LIBERO 与 Trap-RoboTwin。

LIBERO-CTRL.source_title: Beyond Single-Axis Testing: Paired Evaluation of Compound Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Policies
LIBERO-CTRL.source_basis: 论文摘要明确将 LIBERO-CTRL 定义为六轴复合鲁棒性 benchmark。

LIBERO-Para.source_title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
LIBERO-Para.source_basis: 摘要明确说明在 LIBERO-Para 上评估 instruction sensitivity。

RoboStress.source_title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
RoboStress.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce RoboStress controlled simulation benchmark。

BAVO-Bench.source_title: Recovering the View: Benchmarking Physical Active Vision for Occlusion Recovery in Robotic Manipulation
BAVO-Bench.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce BAVO-Bench。

DriveDegrade.source_title: A Degradation-Tolerance Benchmark for Camera-Only End-to-End Driving
DriveDegrade.source_basis: arXiv 页面完整标题为 When Does Corruption Break the Plan? A Degradation-Tolerance Benchmark for Camera-Only End-to-End Driving，摘要明确写明 present DriveDegrade benchmark。

VLN-Safe.source_title: Successful but Unsafe: An Analytical Benchmark for Revealing Collisions in Vision-and-Language Navigation
VLN-Safe.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce VLN-Safe，并在 R2R-CE 上评估。

RoboCasa365.source_title: RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots
RoboCasa365.source_basis: RoboCasa-Shift 论文明确说明其 benchmark built on RoboCasa365；原始 RoboCasa365 论文不在当前 192 条本库记录中。

BEHAVIOR-1K.source_title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
BEHAVIOR-1K.source_basis: ManiUnit 论文明确说明其数据与 benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities；BEHAVIOR-1K 原始论文不在当前 192 条本库记录中。

Open X-Embodiment.source_title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
Open X-Embodiment.source_basis: AgiBot World Colosseo 论文使用 Open X-Embodiment；官方仓库也将该论文列为 Open X-Embodiment 的首篇论文。

RoboComb.source_title: Exploring the Limits of Combinatorial Generalization in Embodied Manipulation
RoboComb.source_basis: 摘要实际使用名称 RoboCombine；本库正则将其收录为 RoboComb，属于名称缩写/变体。

RoboReel.source_title: Monkey See, Can Monkey Do? A Benchmark for Evaluating Robot Skill Learning by Observation
RoboReel.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce RoboReel unified benchmark。

SafePlan-Bench / Safe-Align.source_title: A Framework for Benchmarking and Aligning Task-Planning Safety in LLM-Based Embodied Agents
SafePlan-Bench / Safe-Align.source_basis: 摘要明确将 SafePlan-Bench 定义为测量框架、Safe-Align 定义为对齐方法。

RoboAbstention.source_title: The Yes-Man Syndrome: Benchmarking Abstention in Embodied Robotic Agents
RoboAbstention.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce RoboAbstention。

DESPITE.source_title: Using Large Language Models for Embodied Planning Introduces Systematic Safety Risks
DESPITE.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce DESPITE benchmark。

MineAmongUs.source_title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions
MineAmongUs.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 introduce MineAmongUs 3D multimodal sandbox。

nuScenes.source_title: nuScenes: A Multimodal Dataset for Autonomous Driving
nuScenes.source_basis: nuScenes 是当前 DriveDegrade、ExceptionDrive 等条目的底层数据集；原始数据集论文不在当前 192 条本库记录中。

ExceptionDrive.source_title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
ExceptionDrive.source_basis: 摘要明确写明 proposed ExceptionDrive counterfactual planning benchmark。

R2R-CE.source_title: Bridging the Gap Between Learning in Discrete and Continuous Environments for Vision-and-Language Navigation
R2R-CE.source_basis: 该工作将 R2R 路径转换到连续环境并构造 VLN-CE/R2R-CE 评测设置；当前表中的 VLN-Safe 是使用论文。
